name: TR8×4(P2) · Surpass Hobby KK2845 3100KV · 4 outputs · Ø86 formed aluminium / PETG · ±20°
description: Lightened formed 5052-O panels, Ø86 metal end discs and four dense pocketed PETG quadrants with overlapped seams and intentional motor/gear windows. Twenty additional M3×0.5 stand threads follow the output-axis five-point sketch with Ø3.4 PETG shank passages; the external stand is not included. Four motor cable routes and separate reserve grooves use the enlarged end ports. Motor positions remain unchanged; nominal overall height 125.212 mm. One DIN7991 M3×6 cover screw per quadrant; the actual BOM records its configuration.
